user.title: Configure Midnite Solar device
user.description: Enter the IP address and port of your Midnite Solar Classic device.
user.description_discovered: A Midnite Solar device was discovered at {{ ip }} (MAC: {{ mac }}). Review or modify the connection details and update interval before adding it.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the device. Please check the IP address and port.
error.cannot_read: Cannot read from the device. Please verify the device is online and accessible.
error.cannot_set_unique_id: Failed to set unique ID for the device
error.missing_host: Enter the IP address of the Classic.

abort.cannot_set_unique_id: Failed to set unique ID for the device
abort.unique_id_mismatch: This Classic has a different MAC address than the one this entry was created for.
abort.reconfigure_success: The Classic has been updated and is reloading.
abort.unknown: An unexpected error occurred while contacting the Classic.

data.scan_interval: Classic poll interval (seconds) - how often the Modbus wire is read for live bridge data
data.sensor_interval: Sensor update interval (seconds) - how often readings are republished to Home Assistant's history
data.bridge_enabled: Expose the bridge API so a desktop app can watch and write the Classic (reads become public on the LAN; writes need the PIN below)
data.write_pin: 6-digit write PIN - required on every call that changes the Classic. Writes stay off until you change this from 000000; wrong guesses cost exponentially longer waits

error.invalid_write_pin: The write PIN must be exactly 6 digits and not the 000000 placeholder - set a real one to enable writes.
